citation.quote: The Texas Heart Institute Cardiovascular Perfusion Program at Baylor College of Medicine offers a post-baccalaureate certificate in perfusion technology.
The 18-month course trains students to use the cardiopulmonary bypass machine and other equipment associated with open-heart surgery.
For each class, we accept a maximum of 8 students.

Deborah Lowery Adams, MA, LP, CCP

Director and Clinical Coordinator, Cardiovascular Perfusion Program
The 18-month course trains students to use the cardiopulmonary bypass machine and other equipment associated with open-heart surgery.

The Texas Heart Institute Cardiovascular Perfusion Program at Baylor College of Medicine is accredited by the Commission on Accreditation of Allied Health Education Programs (CAAHEP) upon the recommendation of the Accreditation Committee for Perfusion Education (ACPE), and graduates are eligible to become a Certified Clinical Perfusionist after they take the national certification examination, which is given by the American Board of Cardiovascular Perfusion.
